(BBC — Chris Mason analysis of the poll; YouGov data)
Cross-ref: Andy Burnham became PM 20 Jul 2026 — https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/20/world/live-news/andy-burnham-uk-prime-minister-intl

Reform UK poll lead / "Burnham bounce" (August 2026):
- Polling by YouGov puts Reform UK first nationally at 23%, up slightly from a dip to 22% the
  previous week (after 25% in early July/June). Labour remains on 22%, pushing it into second.
- The widely anticipated bounce for Labour after deposing its leader and installing a new one
  (Andy Burnham) has barely materialised; the latest national poll again gives Nigel Farage's
  Reform UK a narrow lead.
- Context: Andy Burnham became UK Prime Minister on 20 July 2026 — the country's seventh prime
  minister in a decade (CNN, Al Jazeera live). Chancellor: John Healey. Home Secretary:
  Shabana Mahmood (per today's morning brief).
